logline: Gerald and Clarissa arrive at the cottage with an armed constable accusing Alexander of grand theft, culminating in a devastating planted discovery that threatens to tear the newlyweds apart.
continuity_notes: Picks up immediately after the intimate moment between Juliana and Alexander in Episode 10, interrupted by the ominous arrival of an aristocratic carriage carrying Gerald.

blocks.text: Low-angle tracking shot of heavy carriage wheels churning violently through the muddy, waterlogged track.
Squelch of mud and the grinding rattle of carriage wheels under heavy rain.
Medium two-shot of Juliana and Alexander standing outside the rustic stone cottage, watching the incoming carriage with tense apprehension.
Juliana wrings a damp rag in her hands, her face etched with rising dread, while Alexander stands guard beside her.
Tight shot tilting up as polished black boots step down directly into the muck, revealing Gerald clad in an opulent burgundy double-breasted coat.
Gerald buttons his coat, smug self-satisfaction radiating from his expression.
Medium shot of a uniformed Constable descending from the carriage, firmly gripping a wooden truncheon.
Medium tracking shot as Juliana steps defensively toward Gerald, her face full of shock and anger.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Gerald? What are you doing here?"
Wide two-shot across the puddle-strewn ground between Gerald and Juliana against the misty landscape.

blocks.speaker: GERALD
blocks.text: "I came for something that belongs to me."
Close-up of Clarissa peering from the carriage window in her violet silk gown, a venomous, triumphant smile curling her lips.
Close-up of Juliana, her anger flaring as she gestures sharply.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "You have already taken enough from me. Leave!"
Medium close-up of Gerald pointing an accusatory finger, his composure snapping into hostile anger.

blocks.speaker: GERALD
blocks.text: "Your husband stole my gold pocket watch!"
Close-up of Juliana recoiling in utter disbelief.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "What? When?"
Close-up of Gerald narrowing his eyes vindictively.

blocks.speaker: GERALD
blocks.text: "The last time I came here."
Medium shot of Juliana scoffing, stepping forward as Alexander stands motionless behind her.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "You never even entered the cottage!"
Close-up of Gerald smirking with condescending amusement.

blocks.speaker: GERALD
blocks.text: "Then you should have nothing to fear from a search."
Three-shot of Alexander, Juliana, and Gerald in the bleak drizzle.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Alexander would never steal from you."
Low-angle shot of Gerald throwing his head back in arrogant, mocking laughter.

blocks.speaker: GERALD
blocks.text: "Of course you would defend him. You married a beggar!"
Medium close-up of Alexander stepping past Juliana, his gaze murderous and jaw rigid.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Choose your next words carefully."
Medium shot of Gerald pointing back toward the approaching Constable, feigning alarm.

blocks.speaker: GERALD
blocks.text: "You hear that? He threatens me again!"
Medium shot of the Constable marching into frame between them, holding his truncheon horizontally.

blocks.speaker: CONSTABLE
blocks.text: "I have received a complaint of theft."
Extreme close-up of Juliana, defiant and resolute.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "A complaint is not proof."
Close-up of the Constable gesturing with his truncheon toward the cottage door.

blocks.speaker: CONSTABLE
blocks.text: "Then a search will settle the matter."
Medium shot of Juliana backing up to the doorway, spreading her arms wide to block the entrance.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "You cannot simply invade our home because this man makes an accusation!"
Medium close-up of Gerald crossing his arms smugly.

blocks.speaker: GERALD
blocks.text: "If he has nothing to hide..."
Extreme close-up push-in on Alexander's scarred face, his eyes smoldering with lethal restraint.

blocks.speaker: GERALD
blocks.text: "...let the constable search."

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Search it."
Medium two-shot of Juliana looking up at Alexander in panicked confusion.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Let them."
Medium shot looking out the doorway as Juliana steps aside and the Constable barges past into the dimly lit cottage.
Heavy thud of boots entering wooden floorboards, followed by forceful banging of furniture.
The Constable begins violently overturning crates and dumping contents across the floor.
Medium low-angle shot of Juliana dropping to her knees, frantically trying to salvage bundles of dried herbs scattering across the boards.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Stop! Those are my mother's medicines!"
The Constable aggressively pulls folded bed linens from a shelf and hurls them onto the damp floor.
Low-angle close-up of Juliana crawling on the floor, looking up with tears streaming down her cheeks.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Please! There is nothing here!"
Close-up of the Constable's hands flipping open a small wooden keepsake box on a work table.

blocks.speaker: CONSTABLE
blocks.text: "Then you have nothing to fear."
Low-angle close-up of Juliana clutching the fallen linens to her chest, her voice breaking.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Those are all I have left!"
Medium shot of Gerald leaning casually against the cottage doorframe, looking around with contemptuous disgust.

blocks.speaker: GERALD
blocks.text: "Stand aside. Look at this place. A perfect hiding hole for a thief."
Medium shot of Juliana rising to her feet, clutching the folded cloth, her face contorting with rage.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "You planted this accusation because you cannot bear that I am happy without you!"
Tight close-up of Gerald's face chilling into a cold sneer.

blocks.speaker: GERALD
blocks.text: "Happy?"
Medium shot of Alexander standing in the cottage shadows, eyes locked onto Gerald.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand slowly tightening into a white-knuckled fist.
Low-angle close-up of Gerald tilting his chin up, daringly baiting Alexander.

blocks.speaker: GERALD
blocks.text: "What is it, soldier? Going to strike a gentleman in front of his wife?"

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "Don't!"
Close-up of Juliana clutching her dress collar in acute panic.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "One blow would end this."
Medium shot of the Constable stepping up behind Alexander, holding his truncheon firmly across Alexander's chest to restrain him, cutting to a tight close-up of Alexander's smoldering eyes.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "But one blow would destroy her life."
Medium shot of the Constable turning to Alexander's heavy trench coat hanging on an iron wall hook by the fireplace.
The Constable grabs the coat by the collar and begins rummaging through its deep pockets.

blocks.speaker: JULIANA
blocks.text: "That is his coat!"
Close-up of the Constable's hand sliding deep inside the inner coat lining and withdrawing a gleaming gold pocket watch with an attached chain.
Metallic clinking of the gold chain sliding against fabric.
Extreme close-up of Juliana gasping in sheer horror, her eyes welling with shock and shattered disbelief.
Juliana draws a sharp, terrified breath as her face pales completely.
Extreme close-up of Alexander's face hardening into lethal, icy comprehension, realizing the depth of the frame-up.
Medium close-up push-in on Gerald's face erupting into an ecstatic, wicked grin, bursting into triumphant laughter.

blocks.speaker: GERALD
blocks.text: "There it is. Ha!"

Tight macro shot of the gold pocket watch dangling and swaying gently from the Constable's fingers on its long chain, with Gerald blurred in the background grinning with sinister triumph as the scene hangs in a devastating freeze-frame.
